git.path.description: The file system path to the git repository containing the notmuch tag database. Corresponds to git.config `git.path`.

git.tag_prefix.description: The prefix string used to filter tags in notmuch. Corresponds to git.config `git.tag_prefix`.

git.log_level.description: Log verbosity level for notmuch-git. One of: critical, error, warning, info, debug.
